_comment: Per-PR demo for the hold-formation catalog re-pin. Brace vs unbraced is the clip whose on-screen claim actually changed: both spear lines now hold until the cavalry arrives, and the contrast is knockback on impact rather than the unbraced line walking forward.
caption: Hold-formation default, catalog re-pin: two identical Spearmen lines wait in place for the same cavalry charge. The right line is ordered to Brace and holds its ground on impact; the left is left at the no-order default and is driven back. The clip runs to 320 frames so both charges land (the left-hand pair only meets around tick 520).
